content: परिसंख्या €2 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To count or reckon up, add together. .²2 To enumerate. .²3 To make good, restore.

परिसंख्या .²1 Enumeration, computation. .²2 Sum, total, number: वित्तस्य विद्यापरिसंख्यया मे <ls>R. 5. 21</ls>. .²3 (In <ab>Mīm. phil.</ab>) Exclusion, specification, limitation to that which is enumerated or expressly mentioned, so that everything else is excluded; सांख्यदर्शनमेतावत् परिसंख्यानुदर्शनम् <ls>Mb. 12. 306. 42</ls>. [परिसंख्या is opposed to विधि which lays down a rule for the first time, and to नियम which restricts the choice to an alternative which is expressly stated when several such alternatives are possible]; विधिरत्यन्तमप्राप्तौ नियमः पाक्षिके सति . तत्र चान्यत्र च प्राप्तौ परिसंख्येति गीयते .. {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} पञ्च पच्चनखा भक्ष्याः usually quoted by the Mīmāṃsakas; अयं नियमविधिर्न तु परिसंख्या <ls>Kull.</ls> on <ls>Ms. 3. 45</ls>. प्राप्तस्य पुनर्वचनं परिसंख्यार्थं भवति <ls>ŚB. on MS. 11. 1. 66</ls>. परिसंख्या also means a text laying down exclusion; <ab>cf.</ab> (विधिपरिसंख्यासंशये विधिर्ज्यायान् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 4. 7</ls>); also परिसंख्यायां स्वार्थहानिः, परार्थकल्पना, प्राप्तबाधश्च . .²4 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Special mention or exclusive specification, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} where with or without a query something is affirmed for the denial, expressed or understood, of something else similar to it; (this figure is particluarly striking when it is based on a श्लेष or pun); यस्मिन् महीं शासति चित्रकर्मसु वर्णसंकराश्चापेषु गुणच्छेदः <ab>&c.</ab> or यस्य नूपुरेषु मुखरता विवाहेषु करग्रहणं तुरङ्गेषु कशाभिघातः <ab>&c.</ab> K; for other examples see <ls>S. D. 735</ls>. .²5 Recapitulation.
